x-mcp-tools.name: list_agents
x-mcp-tools.description: List configured local adapters and their admitted capabilities.

x-mcp-tools.name: delegate_task
x-mcp-tools.description: Create or replay one durable delegation using the supplied command key.

x-mcp-tools.name: inspect_task
x-mcp-tools.description: Read the durable task snapshot, replay cursor bounds, and optional one-time local dashboard bootstrap.

x-mcp-tools.name: wait_task
x-mcp-tools.description: Wait for persisted task events strictly after an explicit replay cursor. Use until=attention to hold until a terminal result or pending approval/input, instead of returning on every text page.

x-mcp-tools.name: send_task_input
x-mcp-tools.description: Answer one current durable interaction using its exact generation, nonce, and digest.

x-mcp-tools.name: cancel_task
x-mcp-tools.description: Persist cancellation intent for one task using a durable command key.

x-mcp-tools.name: review_task
x-mcp-tools.description: Record a verdict and acknowledge the exact terminal result identity.

x-mcp-tools.name: improvement_case
x-mcp-tools.description: Inspect a guarded improvement case or submit an allowlisted candidate/rollback command.

notice.const: Bootstrap URL is single-use and must not be logged or persisted.
